R Kingscote stated that his mount lay in throughout the event, particularly when placed under pressure in the Home Straight.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Lay in near the 200 Metres when it made contact with PRESTIGE GOOD.  Protest/objection (see PRESTIGE GOOD).  When questioned regarding the horse racing in a more forward position H T Mo stated that from the inside barrier he was instructed to endeavour to hold a more forward position than its recent starts.  He said after making use of his mount from the start WINNING WING showed more pace in the early stages than it had at its previous race starts which resulted in it holding a more forward position.  Sent for sampling post-race.

The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in when they observed an incident had occurred near the 200 Metres which cast doubt on whether WINNING WING (H T Mo) should be declared the winner of the race.  Subsequently R Kingscote, rider of PRESTIGE GOOD, second placegetter, lodged a protest/objection against WINNING WING being declared the winner alleging interference near the 200 Metres.  After considering the evidence the Stewards found that PRESTIGE GOOD became unbalanced when crowded by WINNING WING near the 200 Metres but having regard to the manner in which both horses finished the race off and where the incident occurred, they could not be comfortably satisfied that had the interference not occurred PRESTIGE GOOD would have finished in advance of WINNING WING and therefore the protest/objection was overruled and weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  H T Mo was reprimanded and advised that he must stop riding and straighten his mounts when they shift ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.

A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be lame in its right front leg.  The performance of MEANINGFUL DRAGON was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MEANINGFUL DRAGON will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments. <5/3/2026 25 January 2026 Sha Tin Racemeeting – Race 7 (380)> Additional diagnostic assessments performed on the horse did not reveal any significant findings.
